query: Which causal identification strategies (policy discontinuities, instrumental variables, panel repeats, DiD, synthetic controls) are most feasible in African settings to link cohesion antecedents to outcomes?

response.query: Which causal identification strategies (policy discontinuities, instrumental variables, panel repeats, DiD, synthetic controls) are most feasible in African settings to link cohesion antecedents to outcomes?
response.answer: In African settings, instrumental variables and Difference-in-Differences (DiD) are most feasible for linking cohesion antecedents to outcomes due to their adaptability to local contexts and data availability.
